summary: The XVII BRICS Summit declaration from Rio de Janeiro, consolidating the group's position on Global South cooperation, financial architecture reform, and anti-corruption measures.

anti_corruption_milestones.deliverable: Endorsement of the 'BRICS Common Vision and Joint Action on Enhanced Anti-Corruption Cooperation and Recovery and Return of Assets and Proceeds of Corruption'.
priorities: Asset recovery and return (repatriation of proceeds)
Denial of safe haven for corrupt officials
Combatting the use of cryptocurrencies for illicit financial flows (IFFs)
anti_corruption_milestones.principles: Non-politicized technical cooperation based on UNCAC.

new_mechanisms.name: BRICS Multilateral Guarantees (BMG)
new_mechanisms.status: Pilot initiative incubated within NDB to de-risk strategic investments.

new_mechanisms.name: BRICS Cross-Border Payments Initiative
new_mechanisms.status: Interoperability focus; supported by the BPTF Technical Report.

financial_innovation_and_resilience.local_currencies: Tasked ICM to find acceptable mechanisms for financing in local currencies.

global_governance_reforms.imf_world_bank: Call for quota realignment (17th GRQ) and 2025 World Bank Shareholding Review to correct Global South underrepresentation.
global_governance_reforms.taxation: Support for the UN Framework Convention on International Tax Cooperation to combat tax evasion and IFFs.
global_governance_reforms.unsc: Reiteration of support for Brazil, India, and Africa's aspirations for permanent seats.

data_and_ai_governance.data_economy: Adoption of the 'BRICS Data Economy Governance Understanding' as a roadmap for data sovereignty and interoperability.
data_and_ai_governance.ai_framework: Endorsement of the 'BRICS Leaders’ Statement on the Global Governance of AI', emphasizing UN central role.
